name: zopkit-bug-resolution-mcp
description: MCP server for Zopkit wrapper bug reports: fetch full bug context (with screenshots), submit how a bug was fixed, list bugs assigned to you, file new bug reports, report your Claude Code usage status, and report a real weekly token-usage breakdown from your local transcripts. Requires a BUG_REPORT_API_KEY (generated in the company-admin panel) — see README.md.
